title: The Wheel-Turning Monarch (Cakkavatti Sutta, Dīgha Nikāya 26)
description: The Pāli Long Discourse on the wheel-turning monarch in Bhikkhu Sujato's English translation (SuttaCentral, CC0): the decline and recovery of human lifespan and the arising of the next buddha, Metteyya, in Ketumatī, the renamed Varanasi.
